en.title: Think Sparse, Predict Dense: Continuous Thought Machines for Image Super-Resolution
en.desc: A continuous-thought architecture that turns compact latent reasoning into dense, spatially aligned queries for progressive image super-resolution.

zh.title: 稀疏思考，密集预测：面向图像超分辨率的连续思维机器
zh.desc: 一种连续思维架构，将紧凑的潜在推理转化为空间对齐的密集查询，实现渐进式图像超分辨率。

en.title: BresNet: Applying Residual Learning in Backpropagation Neural Networks
en.desc: A novel residual learning model improves prediction of multiple air pollutants from satellite data.

zh.title: BresNet: 在反向传播神经网络中应用残差学习预测主要空气污染物地面浓度
zh.desc: 一种新颖的残差学习模型，利用卫星数据改进了多种空气污染物的预测。

en.title: Super-resolution reconstruction of 3 arc-second global DEM dataset
en.desc: A deep learning approach improves global DEM resolution, reducing ocean mapping needs.

zh.title: 3角秒全球DEM数据集的超分辨率重建
zh.venue: 第十一届地质资源管理学术会议
zh.desc: 一种深度学习方法，提高了全球DEM分辨率，减少了海洋测绘的需求。
